svg.title: The project rack of electrifiedchan
svg.desc: A hand lifts four project records out of a rack one at a time and plays each on a turntable. While a record spins, the display below types out the project describing itself: G.U.A.R.D., an AI interview coach; GitReal, resume verification against real GitHub code; TeamTruth, an AI memory for teams that flags contradictions; and ExamHub, automated exam seating plans.

g.text: Full-stack developer · Data Science student · Applied AI.
Turning ideas into useful software, one experiment at a time.
I'm your AI interview coach. I run resume-aware practice rounds,
track gaze and delivery in real time, and replay every session.
I check resumes against real GitHub code, claim by claim.
Then you pick my mood: Roast it or Rewrite it.
I'm an AI memory for teams. I remember every update
and flag contradictions before they turn into problems.
I turn a CSV of students into optimised exam seating plans,
with seat lookup, conflict resolution and attendance sheets.
